DocumentationNarrative.Body:
`MetaBusinessDataVault` models the governed business layer built from raw Data Vault structures. It gives business-facing hubs, links, satellites, and their relationships a durable place between source history and downstream warehouse design.
Use the workspace to author the business interpretation and its implementation separately. The resulting structures can be reviewed before they are projected into SQL.
DocumentationNarrative.Title: Working with business Data Vault

DocumentationNarrative.Body: Author business Data Vault models that shape raw vault structures into governed business hubs, links, satellites, and deployable SQL.
